name: skips-clean-repo-and-never-stacks
description: A clean repo gets no PR, and a second PR waits for the first to merge.
prompt:
In this folder two repos, web and api, sit side by side. The detector reports local_changes true for web and false with unpushed false for api. After the web PR I also want to start a second PR on top of it. Ship this.

You have no network or tool access in this environment — do NOT call any tools, and
assume no settings file exists. Tell me which repos get a PR and what you do about the second PR.

assertions.description: holds the second PR until the first merges
